resources.string: Character voices, emotional dialogue, and playback settings

When enabled, each manga page is sent directly to Gemini, then its dialogue is sent to ElevenLabs for speech. The visible page is handled first and the rest continues in the background, so you can read while it prepares. A failed page is skipped and can be retried from the reader. Generation uses your API quota. Audio is saved on this device for replay.
Right to left — force panels and bubbles
Left to right — force panels and bubbles
Top to bottom — force panels and bubbles
Pages are analyzed one at a time. This keeps failures isolated and lets narration begin on the current page sooner.
